output.source_text: The diminished scale is an 8-note scale with a recurring symmetric pattern of alternating whole steps and half steps (or half steps and whole steps). Because of its 3-semitone interval symmetry, there are only 3 unique diminished scales in total.

note_vi: Bài 23 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 01:20-02:06. The diminished scale is an 8-note scale with a recurring symmetric pattern of alternating whole steps and half steps (or half steps and whole steps). Because of its 3-semitone interval symmetry, there are only 3 unique diminished scales in total. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
